name: JW Marriott Costa Elena Resort & Spa, All-Inclusive
insider_take: Nestled along the sun-drenched shores of Bahia Salinas — one of Costa Rica's best-kept secrets — the JW Marriott Costa Elena Resort & Spa delivers an all-inclusive luxury escape where howler monkeys serenade you at sunrise and world-class windsurfing awaits just steps from your suite.
whats_special: Part of Marriott's prestigious Luminous All-Inclusive Program , Costa Elena sits on the northern tip of Guanacaste, bordering Nicaragua, where the dramatic landscape of Bahia Salinas creates some of the most consistent trade winds in the Americas — making it a globally recognized kite-surfing and windsurfing destination. The resort is surrounded by the Santa Rosa National Park ecosystem, home to sea turtles, tropical wildlife, and pristine mangroves, blending five-star luxury with raw, untouched nature in a way few resorts in Central America can match.
pro_tip: Book a sunset boat tour out of Bahia Salinas — the bay's position at the Gulf of Papagayo creates jaw-dropping golden-hour views and frequent dolphin sightings. As a Luminous All-Inclusive guest, ask the concierge about included excursion credits to maximize your adventure budget.
dont_miss: The award-winning Spa by JW offers treatments inspired by ancient Costa Rican healing rituals using locally sourced volcanic minerals and tropical botanicals. And if you're a wind sports enthusiast, the legendary kite-surfing conditions at Bahia Salinas — consistently ranked among the top 10 spots in the world — are an absolute must-experience right outside the resort's doorstep.
pros: Premium All-Inclusive Experience – Elevated dining, top-shelf spirits, and curated activities are seamlessly included, reflecting JW Marriott's luxury standard.
Stunning Beachfront Setting – Nestled along the pristine shores of Bahia Salinas, Costa Rica, guests enjoy dramatic Pacific Ocean views and direct beach access.
World-Class Spa & Wellness – The on-site spa offers signature treatments inspired by Costa Rican nature, providing a deeply restorative and authentic wellness retreat.
Marriott Bonvoy & Luminous Program Perks – Loyalty members benefit from exclusive privileges, points earning, and curated Luminous experiences that add exceptional value.
Immersive Eco-Luxury Environment – Surrounded by Costa Rica's rich biodiversity and lush landscapes, the resort offers guided nature experiences and a genuine pura vida atmosphere.
cons: Secluded Location – Bahia Salinas is a remote destination, requiring longer travel times from major airports and limiting easy access to outside dining or attractions.
Premium Price Point – As a luxury all-inclusive property, rates are significantly higher than regional alternatives, which may not suit all budgets.
Windy Coastal Conditions – The Bahia Salinas area is known for strong trade winds, which can occasionally affect beach and outdoor comfort, though it's ideal for kitesurfing enthusiasts.
